title: @AutoFactory and @Inject should not be used in the same type.
summary: It is an experimental check, so Error Prone does not turn it on by default.

title: AutoValue instances should not usually contain boxed types that are not Nullable. We recommend removing the unnecessary boxing.
summary: Error Prone turns it on by default.

title: Defaults for AutoValue Builders should be set in the factory method returning Builder instances, not the constructor.
summary: Error Prone turns it on by default.

title: Arguments to AutoValue constructor are in the wrong order.
summary: Error Prone turns it on by default.

title: Make toString(), hashCode() and equals() final in AutoValue classes, so it is clear to readers that AutoValue is not overriding them.
summary: Error Prone turns it on by default.

title: AutoValue recommends using immutable collections.
summary: Error Prone turns it on by default.

title: Do not refer to the autogenerated AutoValue_ class outside the file containing the corresponding @AutoValue base class.
summary: Error Prone turns it on by default.
